text_01: A complete cryptographic research platform: a fabricated dual-core RISC-V SoC, its custom board, and the software to operate it.
text_03: Full-chip design, peripheral and control RTL. Integrated third-party Ibex, AES, Ascon and Xoodyak IP.
text_04: FPGA validation, ASIC implementation and chip testing. Place-and-route and sign-off with the imec team.
text_05: Custom PCB, Python/C libraries, GUI, CLI and documentation. Power-trace analysis is ongoing.
text_06: Synthesis in Cadence Genus for GlobalFoundries 22FDX; functional and SDF-annotated gate-level verification in Xcelium.
text_07: Place-and-route, sign-off and GDSII with the imec team; 28-pin ceramic DIP bonding diagram.
text_08: Custom ChipWhisperer CW308 target board (Altium, 4-layer, 0.01 Ω shunt) with an automated CPA/TVLA evaluation flow.
text_09: Stylized PROACT floorplan. Amber identifies peripheral and control RTL I designed; grey identifies integrated third-party IP.
text_11: I designed the full-chip architecture, integration, and peripheral and control logic. Ibex and the AES, Ascon and Xoodyak co-processors are integrated third-party IP.
